notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
Tranquil Studios has a new game coming out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/924520/Sunny_Shine_Funland/

Follow TranquilStudios (@TranquilVNs) on Twitter and our Store page on Steam to keep up with our future projects as well as our upcoming release, Sunny Shine Funland!

Oakwood Academy of Spells and Sorcery has been patched up!
- Many text errors have been fixed as well as some buggy sprite images.

In the meantime, check out Oakwood Academy of Spells and Sorcery! Take part in the everyday antics of this magical academy! Love is in the air, rivalries are fierce between fellow students, and wacky surprises are around every corner! Guide a freshman named Thomas Middleton through all the madness that comes with being the new guy on campus! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/818940/Oakwood_Academy_of_Spells_and_Sorcery/
